units.source_text: 驹子好像估量贵重物品似的，把“哈蒂”上的垂穗托在掌心上掂了几下：

en.t: Komako seemed to be weighing something precious as she held the drooping ear from the hatte in her palm and bounced it lightly a few times:

units.source_text: “多好的稻子，就是摸摸它，心情也舒畅哩。

en.t: What fine rice this is; just touching it makes me feel good.
It is completely different from last year!

units.source_text: 说着，她眯缝着眼睛，好像在欣赏稻子，顿有感触。

en.t: As she said this, she narrowed her eyes as though savoring the rice, suddenly moved by the feeling of it.

units.source_text: 在她的头顶上空，低低地飞过一群散乱的麻雀。

en.t: Above her head, a scattered flock of sparrows flew low through the air.
